user.title: Create a room rule
user.description: Choose a Home Assistant area and its presence binary sensor. Shelly sensors are supported through their regular Home Assistant entity.

data_description.name: Usually the room name or the room and person's name.
data_description.area_id: Only switchable entities assigned to this area will be offered next.
data_description.presence_entity: The binary sensor must be on while presence is detected and off when the room is empty.

targets.title: Choose what to turn off
targets.description: Only explicitly selected entities are controlled. Adding another device to the area later will not turn it off automatically.

data_description.target_entities: The list includes entities in the selected area whose domain currently provides a turn-off action.

conditions.title: Delay and day conditions
conditions.description: Holiday takes priority when both day sensors are on. If you use one combined ‘Shabbat or holiday’ sensor, select it as the Shabbat sensor and leave Holiday empty. An unavailable configured day sensor blocks shutdown unless every day type is allowed.

data_description.delay: How long the room must remain empty before entities are turned off.
data_description.shabbat_entity: On means Shabbat/special day; off means an ordinary day unless Holiday is on.
data_description.holiday_entity: On means holiday and overrides the Shabbat sensor.
data_description.allowed_day_types: When the deadline passes on a blocked day, the rule waits and runs if the day later becomes allowed while the room is still empty.

error.no_supported_entities: No entities with a turn-off action are assigned to this area. Assign devices to the area in Home Assistant and try again.
error.invalid_delay: Choose a delay between 0 seconds and 30 days
error.day_type_required: Select at least one day type
error.same_gate_entity: Choose different sensors for Shabbat and holiday
error.gate_required: Choose a Shabbat/holiday sensor, or allow all day types
error.entity_not_found: The selected entity no longer exists. Choose it again.
error.target_not_allowed: Choose only entities from this room that support turn off.
